ios.desc:
Not another "just breathe" app. ILTY is the AI mental wellness companion that talks back, challenges your thinking, and ends every session with real steps you can take today.

Built for overthinkers, the chronically anxious, and anyone who needs to think out loud at 2am. Not for everyone. Not trying to be.

FIVE COMPANIONS, FIVE STYLES
Mr. Relentless gives you direct, no-BS accountability. Stoic Advisor reframes your thinking without reinforcing it. The Architect breaks down complex problems. Mindful Guide meets you where you are. Ember adapts to you over time.

No scripts. No forced exercises. You check in, rate your mood, talk it out, and walk away with specific actions. Not affirmations. Actions.

WHEN TALKING IS TOO MUCH
The Toolkit has 19 short practices for hard moments: physiological sigh, box breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, riding a panic wave, anger spikes, breaking a rumination loop. Pick how you feel and start. No conversation required.

Guided meditations in a real voice, from four minutes — for calming down, or for getting to sleep.

All of it works with no signal. Plane, subway, dead zone.

OR DON'T TYPE AT ALL
Talk out loud and your companion answers in a real voice. Stop talking and your turn sends on its own. Or use the mic to dictate into the field and send it as text.

A COMPANION THAT REMEMBERS
Your companion holds onto the people and details that matter to you. Each week they write you a letter about where you have been; each month, a longer Monthly Mirror.

Track your mood before and after every session. Set goals and hit milestones. Export a private PDF for a therapist — summaries only, never your raw conversations.

Your history is saved in your own iCloud, under your Apple ID. No data selling. No ads. No one reads your conversations.

ILTY is not a replacement for professional therapy. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 (US Suicide & Crisis Lifeline).

quotes.text:
Hey HN. My wife and I built ILTY because we both needed it for different reasons. My wife deals with anxiety. I have a fairly advanced case of procrastination and I kinda low-key feel too comfortable in my life so I cant quite make myself move.

We tried the apps. Calm felt like homework and ChatGPT mostly tells how awesome we are and we need to love ourselves like we are, cant agree with that too much

So we built what we actually wanted, tested with ~50 beta testers and felt good about publishing it. Also, publishing this puts us somewhere on the lower slopes of Cringe Mountain, but here we are so please bear with me

ILTY tracks your mood before and after every conversation, so you can tell whether it helped or whether you just had a pleasant interaction with a very confident machine. It has 5 AI companions with different styles. One of them, Mr. Relentless, is for when you need to get your shit together.

Stack: native SwiftUI (iOS 16+), Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Cloudflare Worker proxy, iCloud Documents for storage so user data stays off our servers, RevenueCat for subscriptions, Firebase Analytics exported to BigQuery.  Just iOS for now yes.

We’re not new to building products. We come from product design and engineering management in larger companies, but mostly hand-waving on meetings and showing pretty figma prototypes. We started in January and shipped to the App Store in April. ClaudeCode and Gstack by Garry Tan certainly helped a lot :]
